events.name: Bash
events.head: Regenerate hub, grep for legacy text, check git state and publish hold
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; echo "== gen"; python3 workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "== grep"; for f in workshop-plan/index.html live/index.html; do echo "$f LC=$(grep -c 'Launch Control' $f) sec=$(grep -c '<section id="tasks"' $f)"; done; echo "== d-prove"; grep -n "d-prove" workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py | head -5; echo "== git"; git status --short -- workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py workshop-plan/index.html live/index.html; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py workshop-plan/index.html live/inde
